sentences.text: Kelluu Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2018-03-09 under the industry code 30310, manufacture of civilian air and spacecraft and related machinery.
A funding round of EUR 15 000 000 is dated 2026-04-14, and the linked sources describe it as a series A.
Earlier funding on record includes a round of EUR 1 000 000 dated 2020-01-28 and five Business Finland decisions between 2018 and 2026, the largest listed at EUR 884 740 for 2022.
An EU project started on 2024-09-01 with EUR 301 500 attached, and three share issues are registered, the latest on 2025-05-22.
Its own site names Terrafame as a customer in a notice dated 2023-10-10, which is what lifts the business level to 6 on the radar's rules.
For the fund the memo says watchlist: the ocean impact reading is Low and no decision row matches, so the next step is to reassess when a new public record appears.
